title: Residual of the ISS-T036CAL-011 fix: an unknown cancelled event that carries NO start time (id only) still holds every UNLINKED Gmail row as unproven-calendar-history, in both scopes, until the state is reset
evidence: Pinned by the test 'RESIDUAL (ISS-TOMBSTONE-001)': calendar [c0, c1 (linked to g1)] + Gmail [g1, g5, g6] + tombstone {id:'ghost',cancelled:true} -> calendarEvents [c0,c1], candidates [g1]; g5 and g6 (no calendar twin) are held. Reach: ONLY Gmail rows with no calendar twin on record (e.g. email-only webinar registrations); never a calendar row, never a Gmail row linked to one, never newStartsBlocked. The hold persists with the stored tombstone row (no expiry; ends with a state reset). An outsider can only trigger it if Google returns the cancelled invite as an id-only resource; with a start (the usual shape for a cancelled invite) only Gmail rows at that exact start (or that exact conference identity) are held.
fix_direction: A bare id cannot be tied to any Gmail row, and holding is the only way to keep 'do not join a meeting cancelled before it was ever stored'. Options for the Approver (Umesh): accept; or add an expiry (needs the first-seen tick stored on the tombstone row, a state-shape change); or drop the hold for id-only tombstones (accepts joining a cancelled meeting through its Gmail copy).

title: REGRESSION vs D-060 floor: a start-carrying unknown tombstone holds only Gmail rows whose start is the exact same instant; a genuinely cancelled meeting whose Gmail copy parses to a different start is scheduled and the bot joins a cancelled meeting
area: packages/meeting-bot/src/calendar/tombstone/unknown-tombstone-reach.ts (starts set, reachesUnlinkedGmail exact match); apps/api/src/gws-gmail.ts extractSessionDateTime (source of Gmail starts)
evidence: Gmail starts are regex-scraped from the mail body and a timezone other than IST/UTC/GMT is silently read as IST (extractSessionDateTime('Date: October 11, 2026 Time: 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM EST') -> 05:30Z, true instant 16:00Z). Probe through recon()+selectAutoRecordItems, 2 scopes x everyWebinar T/F (4 cells identical): no tombstone sched=1; tombstone {id:'ghost',cancelled:true,startTime:'2026-10-11T11:01:00.000Z'} + Gmail g0 starting 11:00Z -> sched=1 (join); tombstone start 10:30Z -> sched=1. Same instant written +05:30 -> held. Base 01635f6 blocked these (legacy: everything; available: every unlinked Gmail row). All-day and recurring-instance (originalStartTime only) tombstones carry no usable start and fall to the broad hold (safe).
fix_direction: Start equality is not a safe selector. Keep the broad hold for any unknown tombstone whose identity is not proven and fix its permanence by expiry (ISS-TOMBSTONE-004), or match by a window (e.g. +-12h) plus title similarity. Add a near-miss test (the approximate-match mutation survived).

title: Trusted-identity tombstone tier holds only the exact normalised URL+start; a Gmail copy of the same cancelled meeting with a differently formed link, or the same start with another URL, is scheduled
area: unknown-tombstone-reach.ts identity branch (a trusted link plus start drops the start fallback)
evidence: Probe, 4 cells identical: tombstone {conference zoom.us/j/123456789, start S} + Gmail zoom.us/w/123456789?tk=abc at S -> sched=1; tombstone {conference meet(1), start S} + Gmail meet(0) at S -> sched=1; same url but Gmail start +1 min -> sched=1. Same url+start and ?pwd variants -> held. Base blocked all of these. Whether a cancelled resource keeps conferenceData is unconfirmed live.
fix_direction: When the tombstone carries a trusted link, hold the union of identity match and start match; see ISS-TOMBSTONE-002 for the start problem.

title: Re-rate of ISS-TOMBSTONE-001 from medium to HIGH: the id-only hold of ALL unlinked Gmail rows is permanent, outsider-triggerable by one send-then-cancel, and on a fresh or reset state near-certain
area: unknown-tombstone-reach.ts unattributed branch; stored tombstone row never expires
evidence: Probe, 5 ticks, both scopes: tick 0 id-only tombstone {id:'ghost',cancelled:true} + unlinked Gmail g5 -> sched=0; ticks 1-4 the tombstone is no longer fetched, g5 still sched=0 cand=0; 40 days later still cand=0, inventory unknown-tombstone + unproven-calendar-history. One cancelled invite from any sender blocks every email-only meeting until a state reset (which re-fetches the baseline). The available-scope baseline has no time filter (gws-calendar.ts, showDeleted:true), so on a fresh install or after a 410 reset EVERY old deleted event is an unknown id-only tombstone: the hold is then the normal state. Unlinked Gmail rows are email-only webinar registrations, the Gmail source's purpose (prevalence not measured).
fix_direction: Expiry bounded by evidence: store first-seen tick and drop the hold after the calendar fetch window; or ignore tombstones whose providerUpdated predates the Gmail row's own message date; or require tombstone organizer == Gmail sender; or an operator release. Needs an Approver decision.

title: Start-copy attack: an outsider cancelled invite carrying a public webinar's start holds the victim's unlinked Gmail row for that webinar
evidence: Probe: tombstone {id,cancelled,startTime:<webinar start>,organizer:'evil@attacker.example'} + unlinked Gmail at that start -> sched=0 in all 4 cells (also free-text link + start, and link without start). Bounded to rows at the copied start; calendar rows and linked pairs unaffected. Subsumed in practice by ISS-TOMBSTONE-004 while id-only holds everything.
fix_direction: Organizer/sender match or expiry, as for 004.

title: Residuals of the fail-closed window rule (fix of ISS-TOMBSTONE-002/003/004): (a) 14-day horizon and 24h windows are assumed policy; (b) a pre-fix stored tombstone row with no clock at all still holds near rows with no expiry; (c) a start-less tombstone first seen with no Google updated is stamped with the first-seen tick as providerUpdated, so a revival of that id carrying an earlier updated would be ignored as stale; (d) a cancelled meeting whose start is more than 14 days past its cancellation time and whose tombstone carries no start is no longer held
evidence: Pinned by tests 'ISS-TOMBSTONE-004/001 ...' (6/6), 'a stored tombstone row with no clock at all ...'. Reach after the fix: calendar rows and linked pairs never; a start-carrying tombstone holds unlinked Gmail rows within 24h of its start (self-expiring); a start-less one holds unlinked rows starting in [T-24h, T+14d] where T = Google updated or first-seen tick. An outsider can still hold the victim's unlinked rows inside those windows (ISS-TOMBSTONE-005 start-copy attack stays open, now bounded and expiring instead of permanent).
fix_direction: Approver (Umesh): confirm or change the 14d / 24h constants; optionally require organiser == Gmail sender for the hold; a live check of Google's cancelled-resource shape (ISS-TOMBSTONE-004 condition 5) decides how often (b)-(d) are reachable.

title: The fail-closed window hold is blanket and renewable: one start-less cancelled invite from any sender holds EVERY unlinked Gmail row starting in [T-24h, T+14d] (title, organiser, sender ignored), and a new cancelled invite with a fresh id before T+14d renews it indefinitely; the converse gaps (windows exceeded) still let a cancelled meeting's Gmail copy be joined
area: tombstone/unknown-tombstone-reach.ts (spans, starts); calendar-client.ts first-seen stamp (stamped only for a key not in previous state, so one id cannot self-renew, but ids are free)
evidence: Checker probes through recon()+selectAutoRecordItems at the meeting's own tick, both scopes x both modes (identical): id-only tombstone, unlinked Gmail copy at +5d: held; +13d held; +15d/+16d NOT held and joined. Unrelated title/organiser (evil@attacker.example, title spam), Gmail meeting +3d: held. Stamp: one id refetched on days 1/5/13 keeps first-seen; a second id first seen day 13 re-holds a day-20 row (held at day 14.5 and day 30), so one send+cancel per 14 days suppresses all email-only meetings continuously. FAIL-OPEN: start-carrying tombstone, Gmail copy +25h/-25h not held (+30h joined at own tick); id-only, copy +16d joined; recurring-instance tombstone (originalStartTime only) with copy +30d joined; cancelled master with the series first start, later instance +21d joined; rescheduled copy +3d joined. All-day (date-only) held by the span rule. Garbage providerUpdated is rejected by validation (no permanent anyTime path from input).
fix_direction: Approver (Umesh): bind the hold to the sender (tombstone organiser == Gmail senderEmail/domain) or require title similarity, and/or cap renewals per organiser; confirm 14d/24h constants; the live check (merge condition 5) of whether cancelled invites carry a start decides how often the blanket start-less span is reachable.
